say:1:1230248001:0.text: This is a perfect fishing spot!
say:1:1230248001:0.source_cn: 这里可是绝佳的钓鱼点！
say:1:1230248001:0.male: This is a perfect fishing spot!
say:1:1230248001:0.female: This is a perfect fishing spot!

say:2:1230248002:0.text: The location's secluded, so hardly anyone comes here to fish.
say:2:1230248002:0.source_cn: 因为位置偏僻，所以很少有人在这钓鱼。
say:2:1230248002:0.male: The location's secluded, so hardly anyone comes here to fish.
say:2:1230248002:0.female: The location's secluded, so hardly anyone comes here to fish.

say:3:1230248003:0.text: Wanna cast a line since you're already here?
say:3:1230248003:0.source_cn: 既然找到这里，要来抛一竿吗？
say:3:1230248003:0.male: Wanna cast a line since you're already here?
say:3:1230248003:0.female: Wanna cast a line since you're already here?

say:4:1230248004:0.text: I've laid the groundbait, so I expect a fairly good haul.
say:4:1230248004:0.source_cn: 我已经打好了窝，钓起来应该会收获不错。
say:4:1230248004:0.male: I've laid the groundbait, so I expect a fairly good haul.
say:4:1230248004:0.female: I've laid the groundbait, so I expect a fairly good haul.
